exploratory_one_sample_t_test.alternative: QAOA seed mean objective is lower than uniform-valid population mean
exploratory_one_sample_t_test.caution: Only three optimizer seeds; this test is descriptive, not secure evidence.

interpretation: Two seeds shifted the overall mean cost downward, but one did not; near-optimal, exact-optimum, and feasible mass were below uniform-valid sampling in all three seeds. Optimization superiority is not reproducible.
